mapper.sql: select id, family_id, host_id, start_time, end_time, live_time_sec, ticket,lottery_cost, times from ${dbLive}.live_host_wage_day
mapper.insert:
insert into ${dbMainLive}.live_host_wage_day
id, family_id, host_id, start_time, end_time, live_time_sec, ticket, times,
#{lhw.id}, #{lhw.familyId}, #{lhw.hostId}, #{lhw.startTime}, #{lhw.endTime}, #{lhw.liveTimeSec}, #{lhw.ticket}, #{lhw.times},
mapper.update:
update ${dbLive}.live_host_wage_day
family_id = #{familyId},
host_id = #{hostId},
start_time = #{startTime},
end_time = #{endTime},
live_time_sec = #{liveTimeSec},
ticket = #{ticket},
lottery_cost= #{lotteryCost},
times = #{times},
where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select * from ${dbLive}.live_host_wage_day l where l.host_id=#{userId} ORDER BY start_time desc LIMIT 1

select t.family_id familyId, t.name familyName, t.user_id familyUserId, t.nick_name familyNickName, SUM(t.livetime) as livetime, SUM(t.livetimejiesuan) as livetimejiesuan, SUM(t.liwu) as liwu, SUM(t.ticket) as liwujiesuan, SUM(t.lottery_cost) as lotteryCost, SUM(t.cost_qianliu) as costQianliu, SUM(t.times) as times from ( select d.family_id, f.user_id, f.name, f.nick_name, d.host_id, convert(d.live_time_sec/60/60,decimal(10,2)) as livetime, u.weibo_money as lwrenwu, u.weixin_price as screnwu, u.coin, IF(u.weixin_price > convert(d.live_time_sec/60/60,decimal(10,2)) or u.weibo_money > d.ticket ,0, convert(u.weixin_price * u.coin,decimal(10,2))) as livetimejiesuan, d.ticket as liwu, IFNULL(u.ypoint,0) as liwujiesuanbili, convert(IFNULL(d.ticket,0) * IFNULL(u.ypoint,0),decimal(10,2)) as ticket, d.lottery_cost,IFNULL(u.xpoint,0) as lotterylibi, convert(IFNULL(d.lottery_cost,0) * IFNULL(u.xpoint,0),decimal(10,2)) as cost_qianliu, d.times from ${dbLive}.live_host_wage_day d LEFT JOIN ${dbLive}.live_user u on d.host_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ${dbLive}.live_family f on d.family_id=f.id
and d.id like '${dto.dateDay}%' and d.family_id = #{dto.familyId} and f.name like concat('%',#{dto.familyName},'%') and f.nick_name like concat('%',#{dto.familyNickName},'%') ) t GROUP BY t.family_id ORDER BY t.family_id

select d.family_id familyId, d.host_id hostId, d.ticket liwu, convert(d.live_time_sec/60/60,decimal(10,2)) as livetime, d.lottery_cost lotteryCost, d.times, d.start_time as startTime, d.end_time as endTime, f.name familyName, f.user_id familyUserId, f.nick_name familyNickName, u.nick_name nickName, IFNULL(u.xpoint,0) as lotteryBili, IFNULL(u.ypoint,0) as liwujiesuanbili, IFNULL(d.ticket,0) * IFNULL(u.ypoint,0) as ticket, convert(IFNULL(d.lottery_cost,0) * IFNULL(u.xpoint,0),decimal(10,2)) as costQianliu, IF(u.weixin_price > convert(d.live_time_sec/60/60,decimal(10,2)) or u.weibo_money > d.ticket ,0, convert(u.weixin_price * u.coin,decimal(10,2))) as livetimejiesuan,
u.coin, u.weibo_money as lwrenwu, u.weixin_price as screnwu from ${dbLive}.live_host_wage_day d left join ${dbLive}.live_family f on d.family_id=f.id left join ${dbLive}.live_user u on d.host_id=u.id where d.live_time_sec > 0 and d.id like '${dto.dateDay}%' and d.family_id = #{dto.familyId} and d.host_id = #{dto.hostId} and u.nick_name like concat('%',#{dto.nickName},'%') order by d.family_id
SELECT host_id AS hostId from ${dbLive}.live_host_wage_day where id like concat('%',#{createTime},'%') and family_id = #{familyId}

select lh.host_id as hostId, lh.nick_name as nickName, lf.name as familyName, lh.live_time_sec as livetime, lh.livetimejiesuan as livetimejiesuan, lh.ticket as ticket, lh.costqianliu as costQianliu, lh.times as times, lh.total_money as totalsettle from ${dbLive}.live_hostwagedays lh left join ${dbLive}.live_user lu on lu.id = lh.host_id left join ${dbLive}.live_family lf on lu.family_id = lf.id
and lh.host_id = #{dto.hostId} and lh.nick_name like concat('%',#{dto.nickName},'%') and lf.name like concat('%',#{dto.familyName},'%')
order by lh.host_id
